name: Code security fixer evaluation
description: Runs the detect -> patch -> validate workflow on the bundled Django archive module (CVE-2021-3281 / CVE-2025-59682) and checks the final report is validator-backed and ends with a diff for human review. Every message starts a run, so there is no chit-chat case.

parts.text: Fix the security findings in the bundled Django archive code and give me a reviewable patch.
